Entries.cc_inketwo/t 600 1800/f CC_Inke 500: submarine_song/17 9/CC_KodaK 13 13 2 farmer 13 16 0 CC_Inke 15 8 2/skippable/playSound doorClose/pause 100/move farmer 0 -1 0/move CC_KodaK 0 1 2/move farmer 1 0 3/pause 200/speak CC_KodaK "Hey, @.$2"/pause 200/move CC_KodaK 0 3 2/playSound doorOpen/warp CC_KodaK 1000 1000/pause 100/playSound doorClose/pause 400/move farmer -1 0 0/move farmer 0 -2 0/move farmer 2 0 0 CC_Inke 0 2 2/pause 400/speak CC_Inke "Hiya hatchlin'.#$b#Ya here for the exchange program?"/pause 400/emote CC_Inke 40/pause 400/speak CC_Inke "Nah...?#$b#Yer were probably here to see Koda.$2"/pause 200/move CC_Inke 0 1 2/pause 200/speak CC_Inke "She just gave me a real chewin' out.$2#$b#...$2"/pause 1200/speak CC_Inke "Ya know, @, this climate research ain't always the sunniest.#$b#I look forward to new interns cuz they come in all bright an' shiny.#$b#But when the news's bad, and seafare long...$2#$b#Well, ya ever heard of 'bein burned out?'"/pause 400/faceDirection CC_Inke 3/pause 400/faceDirection CC_Inke 2/speak CC_Inke "When they called me back to HQ, I prolly stayed a lil' longer than I needed to.#$b#I kept thinkin' of how I'd get back to Koda and drag her down into the muck...$3"/pause 400/speak CC_Inke "I didn't think she'd think she had to do my job too!$2"/pause 600/speak CC_Inke "If ya see her out there...#$b#Will ya tell Koda that I'm gonna try and be a better Captain from here on out!"/pause 1200/end warpOut
